COMMON_CRAWL.redistribution: the licence is non-transferable and non-sublicensable
COMMON_CRAWL.project_interpretation: A recommendation to obtain legal advice before commercial use is not a grant. This repository's own source-registry rule is that an approving state requires a GRANT rather than the absence of a prohibition, and that uncertainty is never permission. So the honest classification is that a review is required, not that the route is open.

HTTP_ARCHIVE.project_interpretation: Neither page carries a licence, terms, copyright or reuse statement. That is recorded as an absence in what was read rather than as a finding that no licence exists.

commercial_purpose_note: A gap would mean an otherwise-viable route is incompatible with the project's commercial purpose. Neither route is established as incompatible; neither is established as compatible. Under the deployment model recorded in docs/CLAUDE.md, local deployment never implies non-commercial use, so this cannot be waved through on the grounds that current use is local.
